package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"

	"example.com/shop/internal/catalog"
)

// The API's list of products as product_policy.go narrows it, as
// TestAPIListsWhatThePolicyNarrows writes it: no one signed in lists only
// the active ones (Narrow), whatever the filter asks, and not the dear one
// either (Read); staff list them all.
func TestListsWhatThePolicyNarrows(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	srv, d := newTestServerOf(t, newTestDependencies(t))
	home, err := d.catalog.CreateCategory(ctx, catalog.NewCategory{Name: "Casa"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	product := func(name string, price int64, status catalog.Status) string {
		t.Helper()
		x, err := d.catalog.CreateProduct(ctx, catalog.NewProduct{Name: name, Price: decimal.NewFromInt(price), Status: status, CategoryID: home.ID})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return x.ID.String()
	}
	plate := product("Prato", 10, catalog.StatusActive)
	cup := product("Copo", 10, catalog.StatusInactive)
	vase := product("Vaso", 5000, catalog.StatusActive)
	url := srv.URL + "/api/v1/products"

	for _, query := range []string{"", "?status=INACTIVE", "?status=ACTIVE,INACTIVE", "?page=1", "?category_id=" + home.ID.String()} {
		got, ids, _ := call(t, "GET", url+query, "nobody")
		if got != http.StatusOK || len(ids) != 1 || !ids[plate] {
			t.Errorf("list%s as no one: %d %v, want only the active one", query, got, ids)
		}
	}
	if got, ids, _ := call(t, "GET", url, "user.staff"); got != http.StatusOK || len(ids) != 3 {
		t.Errorf("list as staff: %d %v, want them all", got, ids)
	}
	if got, ids, _ := call(t, "GET", url+"?status=INACTIVE", "user.staff"); got != http.StatusOK || len(ids) != 1 || !ids[cup] {
		t.Errorf("list of the inactive as staff: %d %v, want the inactive one", got, ids)
	}

	// The total is the narrowed query's: the dear one Read leaves out
	// still counts.
	res, err := asTestPrincipal("nobody").Get(url + "?page=1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	var page struct{ Total int64 }
	if err := json.NewDecoder(res.Body).Decode(&page); err != nil || page.Total != 2 {
		t.Errorf("total as no one: %d (%v), want 2", page.Total, err)
	}

	for id, want := range map[string]int{plate: http.StatusOK, cup: http.StatusNotFound, vase: http.StatusNotFound} {
		if got, _, _ := call(t, "GET", url+"/"+id, "nobody"); got != want {
			t.Errorf("get %s as no one: %d, want %d", id, got, want)
		}
		if got, _, _ := call(t, "GET", url+"/"+id, "user.staff"); got != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("get %s as staff: %d", id, got)
		}
	}
}
